features.title: Living scenes
features.text: Ask Claude for an interactive background – snow that really settles on the roof in your own photo, fireflies that follow your mouse, a thunderstorm on click. Claude writes the scene, looks at it and refines it.

features.title: Session wrap-up
features.text: When Claude finishes, get a short summary, a suggested commit and the key decisions saved to the brain.

features.title: Pull requests from the Git window
features.text: Branch, push and open a PR without leaving VibeDesk – Claude writes the description.

features.title: Tray status
features.text: See which session is waiting for you even while VibeDesk is minimized.

features.title: Budget per project
features.text: A quiet heads-up at 75 % and 100 % of the token or cost budget you set.

features.title: Claude runs your desk
features.text: New desktop tools for Claude: see your other sessions and hand them tasks, check usage and limits, set a budget and leave you a reminder.
